items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] George Rickson was -- he played for all the shows. See, when a man wanted a piano player for the show, they'd get George Rickson.

ctx.x: And I know as a piano player -- I'd like to ask you about some of the piano players of your era. And then later we'll talk -- I want you to really talk about Duke and tell me how you -- and Duke's relationship. But let's start with piano players now.
